summary: Serenity Tracker refreshed for the June 13 evening X posts. New emphasis is on Foosung (093370) as a Korea WF6 bottleneck beneficiary, continued validation of the WF6/tungsten export-control chain, SIVE as a three-month +1900% thesis with US institutions entering, AI-supremacy export-control bottlenecks, and SPCX now trading above a $2.15T market cap.

latestUpdates.type: SIVE / three-month thesis validation / institutions entering
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 回顾自己 3 个月前在 4 SEK 发布的 SIVE long thesis，称该想法已上涨约 1900%，并强调 JPM、Fidelity 等美国机构近期才开始进入。她把 SIVE 称为仅次于 AXTI 的第二大成功 thesis。
latestUpdates.original: It has been 3 months since Serenity posted the SIVE thesis at 4 SEK; she says it is now up about 1900%, with JPM and Fidelity only recently entering positions.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 再次强调 WF6 的三阶供应链影响：她称中国对日本钨出口管制可能导致前驱体短缺和成本上升，影响全球约 25-35% 供应链，并把 Foosung / 093370 放到 SK Hynix 等存储厂商的重要供应链位置上。
latestUpdates.original: Serenity highlighted WF6 third-order effects: China tungsten export controls on Japan may create precursor shortages and cost increases affecting 25-35% of the global supply chain, with Foosung / 093370 important to SK Hynix memory supply chains.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 新提出 Foosung（093370，约 12 亿美元市值）可能成为 WF6 供应链扰动的韩国纯受益标的。她认为日本 WF6 供应受中国钨出口管制冲击，可能影响 SK Hynix、Samsung、TSM 所需的约 25% 供应，Foosung 若占约 10% 供应链，定价权可能上升。她明确说自己没有持仓，只是发布一个早期 idea。
latestUpdates.original: Foosung (093370, about $1.2B MC) looks like a massive beneficiary if China export controls disrupt Japan WF6 supply; Serenity says it may be the best pure-play beneficiary outside China, but she has no position.

latestUpdates.type: AI supremacy wars / upstream export-control bottlenecks
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 把各国互相出口管制导致的上游供应链瓶颈称为 AI supremacy wars 的开始，并以 AXTI 为例，认为未来会继续出现有意思的上游机会。
latestUpdates.original: Serenity says the AI supremacy wars begin, and upstream supply-chain bottlenecks caused by countries export-controlling each other, such as AXTI, should create interesting opportunities.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 提到 SPCX 已经开始交易，并称其市值已经超过 2.15 万亿美元。这强化了她此前对 SpaceX / SPCX 超大体量上市和市场流动性影响的关注。
latestUpdates.original: SPCX is now trading and is over $2.15T+ market cap, reinforcing Serenity’s prior SPCX liquidity and market-structure watch item.

latestUpdates.type: WF6 supply chain / Japan shutdown / export controls
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 继续强调 WF6 供应链风险：她称日本 WF6 supply chain 受到中国出口管制冲击，影响 TSM、Samsung、SK Hynix，并把这放到 AI supremacy 下的全球供应链博弈框架中。她认为日本有许多 obscure monopolies，但尚未完全反向 weaponize。
latestUpdates.original: Japan WF6 supply chain got shut down from China export controls, affecting TSM, Samsung and SK Hynix; Serenity frames it as global supply-chain warfare around AI supremacy.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 在 Subs 中研究 WF6 供应瓶颈，称 Peric Special Gases（688146）是主要受益者。逻辑是中国钨出口管制影响 WF6 成本，WF6 用于 DRAM / NAND，日本与韩国产能可能受扰动，而 Peric 已进入 TSM、Samsung、SMIC 等供应链。她提醒新闻出来时往往偏后，需要观察 ripple effect。
latestUpdates.original: Peric Special Gases may benefit from WF6 bottlenecks caused by tungsten export controls; WF6 is used in DRAM/NAND and Peric has entered TSM, Samsung and SMIC supply chains.

latestUpdates.type: VPEC epiwafer price hikes / IQE Landmark read-through
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 提到 VPEC 今日上调 epiwafer 价格，认为这对 IQE 和 Landmark（3081）有正向瓶颈 read-through，说明 epiwafer 的 pricing power 和需求。她把它与 MTSI 投资 IQE 以锁定产能联系起来，并披露持有 IQE。
latestUpdates.original: VPEC price hikes on epiwafers are a positive bottleneck read-through for IQE and Landmark, following MTSI investment into IQE to secure capacity.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 回顾 2025 高确信 ideas，包括 ALAB、LITE、AAOI、NBIS、RKLB、TSM 等表现，并说 AAOI 从约 30 到 175、市值从约 3B 到 14B；她暗示今天同样小市值区间里的 SIVE 也应获得更多关注。她也承认曾在 ALAB 等细节上出现过偏差。
latestUpdates.original: Serenity reflected that 2025 high-conviction ideas aged well and suggested names in a similar small-cap range today, such as SIVE, may deserve more attention.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 提到 NBIS、ALAB、RKLB 被加入 Nasdaq 100，认为看到 Astera、Rocket Lab 和 Nebius 从小公司成长为 Nasdaq 最大公司之一很有意思。这是对她此前早期成长股框架的验证性事件。
latestUpdates.original: NBIS, ALAB and RKLB got added to Nasdaq 100, which Serenity frames as small companies growing into major Nasdaq constituents.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 解释指数以及 SNDK、MRVL、LITE 等个股转绿，称特朗普取消对伊朗攻击后市场波动很大。这条主要是宏观 headline 对高 beta AI / 光学标的短线价格影响的提醒。
latestUpdates.original: Indexes and names from SNDK to MRVL to LITE turned green after Trump cancelled attacks on Iran; Serenity called the market very volatile.

latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 认为 Anthropic 追求首批数据中心 leases 的消息可能利好 Neocloud colo sector，点名 WULF、CIFR、WYFI、HUT 等。她引用 The Information 称 Anthropic 已与美国开发商签署十多份 LOI。
latestUpdates.original: Anthropic pursuing its first DC leases and signing more than a dozen LOIs may be a tailwind for Neocloud colo names such as WULF, CIFR, WYFI and HUT.

latestUpdates.type: NVDA national champion / supply-chain funding frame
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 将 800V DC 与 CPO 投资框架上升到支持 NVDA 及美国 AI 关键供应链：她认为从良率、substrate、laser capacity、export controls 到 FAU、InP、SiC/GaN 等上游 capacity，投资关键公司可以帮助西方供应链建设。
latestUpdates.original: Serenity frames 800V DC and CPO investing as supporting NVDA and Western AI supply chains across FAU, InP, SiC/GaN and laser-capacity bottlenecks.

latestUpdates.type: AAOI / Western AI optical supply chain
latestUpdates.impactZh: Serenity 称市场应该支持 AAOI 这类 domestic champion，因为美国关键 AI 基建最好从 laser fab 到 production 都在本土。她把 AAOI 与 INTC、IQE、XFAB、MU、WOLF、SOI、SIVE 等一起放入西方关键供应链和补贴框架，并提到 AAOI reshoring 后若达到 471m/month projection 的重要性。
latestUpdates.original: Markets should cheer domestic champions like AAOI; Serenity groups AAOI with INTC, IQE, XFAB, MU, WOLF, SOI and SIVE as critical Western AI supply-chain nodes.
